non_regression.inherit_previous_plan: Preserve all revision16 cause elimination, full-pool bounded recurring-open lifecycle, minute map, optimizer-at-59 ordering, 19-role use, prompt drift guard, two-boundary persistence criterion and semantic Phase-1 fail-closed gates.

instruction_file_problem.finding: No required instruction file is currently missing. However, prior controls did not explicitly guarantee safe recurring behavior when a semantic control or RUN_LIFECYCLE itself is missing or unreadable.
instruction_file_problem.risk: A worker could stop at a failed first read, use stale prompt-only substantive defaults, run into the long invocation boundary, or misclassify the missing file as completion or an irreducible handoff.
instruction_file_problem.selected_fix: Manifest every required exact path, embed an emergency bounded diagnostic fallback in all 19 physical prompts, and make the optimizer validate and safely restore confirmed unexpected missing controls before semantic optimization.

optimizer_mandatory_order: Read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, RUN_LIFECYCLE and all current semantic/scheduler controls before live inventory.
Validate every exact instruction path required by the 19 managed roles; classify present, transient-unreadable or confirmed unexpected 404.
Inspect live physical state and same-task re-enable every stopped enabled_desired role with exact readback.
For a transient file read error, do not recreate or overwrite the file; record and retry next run.

For a confirmed unexpected 404 with no newer explicit user-authorized deletion, retrieve the latest valid same-path version from Git history, validate schema/role/path and fixed constraints, restore only that same path, exact-readback, and refresh manifest blob metadata.
If no safe historical restore exists, keep only the affected role diagnostic-open and enabled; continue all unaffected roles and keep the missing path as an unresolved Phase-1 child.

Compare all 19 physical prompts with PROMPT_LIFECYCLE_ALIGNMENT revision4; update only prompts lacking the manifest reference or embedded missing-instruction fallback and exact-readback the same task id.
Verify the revision16 schedule map and optimizer minute59 ordering; repair only drifted same tasks.
Perform at most one bounded semantic allocation/method effect that fits RUN_LIFECYCLE, persist continuation and normal-return.

missing_instruction_worker_behavior.allowed_effect: At most one compact role-safe diagnostic/readback when an already-authorized surface is safely available.

physical_prompt_apply.apply_scope: only drifted existing managed prompts; do not rewrite compliant prompts
required_for_all_19: read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST and RUN_LIFECYCLE before semantic work
embedded emergency fallback works even when RUN_LIFECYCLE is missing
missing semantic control means diagnostic-open, not stale substantive execution
keep enabled_desired=true and never mutate scheduler
normal return before 20 seconds on instruction-control failure
emit ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: and preserve nonempty retry continuation

failure_switch: Any future missing/unreadable instruction path triggers bounded diagnostic-open behavior and optimizer path repair, not role disablement. Any post-fix physical stop still triggers same-task re-enable and role-specific duration/write/final-marker audit without pool reduction or hard-boundary restoration.
exact_next_action: At optimizer minute59 validate all required paths, physically apply PROMPT_LIFECYCLE_ALIGNMENT revision4 only to drifted prompts, exact-readback all 19 fallback semantics and enabled states, then continue the existing two-boundary lifecycle persistence verification.
